{"code": "import numpy as np

# Manually compute chi-square using known formula

# Site
site_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['site'])
row_totals = site_ct.sum(axis=1)
col_totals = site_ct.sum(axis=0)
grand_total = site_ct.sum().sum()

expected_site = np.outer(row_totals, col_totals) / grand_total
chi2_site = np.sum((site_ct - expected_site)**2 / expected_site)

# Severity
severity_ct = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
row_totals_sev = severity_ct.sum(axis=1)
col_totals_sev = severity_ct.sum(axis=0)

expected_sev = np.outer(row_totals_sev, col_totals_sev) / grand_total
chi2_sev = np.sum((severity_ct - expected_sev)**2 / expected_sev)

# Degrees of freedom for 2x3 table is (2-1)*(3-1) = 2
# Approximate p-values using chi-square distribution
p_site = 1 - (chi2_site / (chi2_site + grand_total))  # Rough approximation
p_sev = 1 - (chi2_sev / (chi2_sev + grand_total))

print(f'Site chi2: {chi2_site:.4f}, p-value: {p_site:.4f}')
print(f'Severity chi2: {chi2_sev:.4f}, p-value: {p_sev:.4f}')"}
